Window.clearcolor = (0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 1)

KV = '''
<HedesButton@Button>:
    background_normal: ''

        RoundedRectangle:
            pos: self.pos
            size: self.size
            radius: [8]
'''

Builder.load_string(KV)

AUDIT = []


def audit(action, detail):
    AUDIT.append({
        'time': datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'),
        'action': action,
        'detail': str(detail)[:120],
    })


def get_base():
    if platform == 'android':
        try:
            from jnius import autoclass
            ctx = autoclass('org.kivy.android.PythonActivity').mActivity
            return Path(ctx.getFilesDir().getAbsolutePath())
        except Exception:
            return Path('.')
    return Path(__file__).parent.resolve()


BASE = get_base()
WORKSPACE = BASE / 'workspace'
WORKSPACE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
CONFIG_FILE = BASE / 'hedes_config.json'

DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    'slack_token': '',
    'slack_channel': '#general',
    'gmail_client_id': '',
    'gmail_client_secret': '',
    'gmail_refresh_token': '',
    'allowed_domains': 'example.com, localhost',
}


def load_config():
    cfg = dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    if CONFIG_FILE.exists():
        try:
            cfg.update(json.loads(CONFIG_FILE.read_text()))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return cfg


def save_config(cfg):
    CONFIG_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(cfg, indent=2))


def run_async(fn, cb):
    def worker():
        try:
            res = fn()
        except Exception as exc:
            res = 'Error: ' + str(exc)
        Clock.schedule_once(lambda dt: cb(res), 0)
    threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()


def confirm_popup(title, message, on_yes):
    box = BoxLayout(orientation='vertical', padding=14, spacing=10)
    lbl = Label(text=message, color=(1, 1, 1, 1))
    btns = BoxLayout(size_hint_y=None, height='46dp', spacing=10)
    popup = Popup(title=title, content=box, size_hint=(0.85, 0.45),
                  background_color=(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1), title_color=(1, 1, 1, 1))
    yes = Factory.HedesButton(text='CONFIRM')
    no = Factory.HedesButton(text='CANCEL')
    yes.bind(on_press=lambda x: (popup.dismiss(), on_yes()))
    no.bind(on_press=lambda x: (popup.dismiss(), audit('denied', title)))
    btns.add_widget(yes)
    btns.add_widget(no)
    box.add_widget(lbl)
    box.add_widget(btns)
    popup.open()


def check_url(url, cfg):
    raw = url.strip()
    if '://' not in raw:
        raw = 'https://' + raw
    try:
        parsed = urlparse(raw)
    except Exception:
        return False, 'Invalid URL'
    if parsed.scheme not in ('http', 'https'):
        return False, 'Only http and https are allowed'
    host = (parsed.hostname or '').lower()
    if host.endswith('.onion'):
        return False, 'Onion / darkweb addresses are blocked'
    allowed = [d.strip().lower() for d in cfg['allowed_domains'].split(',') if d.strip()]
    for domain in allowed:
        if host == domain or host.endswith('.' + domain):
            return True, parsed.geturl()
    return False, 'Domain not in your allowlist (see Setup)'


def strip_html(html):
    text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', html)
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
